claims.claim: Added the explicit task-semantic-v1 decoder with immutable semantic requirements, strict shape/version checks, complete acceptance validation, and rejection of command-shaped obligations and extra authority fields.
TASK bytes contain no self, contract, mapping or source pins. Readiness independently derives raw TASK/source bindings and compares every normalized requirement against the authenticated contract.

The explicit read-only readiness API reuses existing canonical source, coverage, authenticated Human selection and complete Reviewer/Publisher lineage validators without accepting authority callbacks or declaration labels as approval.

Readiness exposes separate structural, source, Human, review, publication and applicability statuses while fixing future admission to NOT_ADMITTED, KA-01 to NOT_ACTIVATED and execution authorization to false.
Legacy parse_task and validate_task bodies remain unchanged. Existing source wrappers retain legacy decoding, and no operative policy or ingress registration was added.

Added focused test definitions covering independently authenticated synthetic positive bindings, circular and cross-subject substitutions, malformed requirements, untrusted authority, unrelated reviews, stale-source/ref races and read-only side effects.
Documented the exact future format, cycle-free source association, explicit invocation, conservative statuses, legacy compatibility and outstanding live mapping, G3 and G6 boundaries.
The final commit changes exactly the eight authorized paths and adds no lifecycle database, scheduler, worker selector, alternate Runtime/Reviewer/Publisher or roadmap mutation.
